login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a one-time sign-in link.
login.sentTitle: The link is on its way
login.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, a sign-in link is on its way there. It's valid for 15 minutes.
login.footnote: No account yet? Open your chata, go to Participants and tap “That's me” next to your name to create one with your email. The chata admin can create it for you too.

errors.captcha: We couldn't verify that you're not a robot. Please refresh the page and try again.
errors.invalid_link: This sign-in link is not valid. Request a new one.
errors.expired_link: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.oauth: Signing in with Microsoft failed. Please try again.
errors.unauthorized: There is no account for this email. Create one on your chata page with “That's me” next to your name, or ask the chata admin.
errors.missing_params: Invalid response from the sign-in service. Please try again.
errors.invalid_state: The sign-in attempt timed out. Please try again.
errors.superadmin_microsoft: Superadmins sign in with Microsoft only; sign-in links are disabled for them.
errors.no_email: We couldn't get your email address from Microsoft. Please try again.

banner.waitingTitle: Your request for {name} is waiting for the admin
banner.waitingBody: We sent it to them on {date}. You'll get an email as soon as they decide.
banner.title: You're viewing as {name}. Is that you?
banner.bodyPendingByOther: Someone has already asked for this link. If it's you, speak up too.
banner.body: Link your account and next time you sign in, you'll go straight to your own view.

dialog.sentBody: A link is on its way to {email}. Click it and you're in; it's valid for 15 minutes. Right after that, the link request goes to the chata admin.
dialog.title: Link {name}
dialog.intro: Linking means the participant's expenses and settlement become yours. The chata admin still has to confirm it.
dialog.firstTimeBody: All we need is your email. We'll send you a verification link instead of a password.

errors.captcha: We couldn't verify that you're not a robot. Please try again.

result.approvedBody: {name} is now yours. Your account is already known from another chata, so no one needed to confirm it.
result.pendingBody: We'll let the chata admin know. Once they confirm it's you, you'll get an email and {name} will be yours.
result.alreadyLinkedBody: {name} is already linked to your account.

errors.participant-locked: This participant is already linked to another active account. Get in touch with the chata admin.
errors.account-has-participant: Your account already has a linked participant in this chata. The chata admin can link more (a child or partner).
errors.generic: Sending the request failed. Please try again.

decide.metaDescription: Approving a request to link a participant with an account

page.missingSignature: The link is missing its signature. Please use the link from the email.
page.expiredBody: Email links are valid for 7 days. You'll find the request in the admin panel under "Claim Requests".
page.badSignature: The link's signature doesn't match. Please use the link from the email.
page.notFoundBody: This link request no longer exists.
page.forbiddenBody: This link belongs to an admin who no longer manages this chata. Ask another admin.
page.goneTitle: This request can no longer be decided
page.goneBody: The participant or the account behind this request has since disappeared. You'll find the request in the admin panel.
page.decidedApproved: The request has already been approved.
page.decidedRejected: The request has already been rejected.
page.decidedClosed: The request is no longer open.

card.approvedBody: {name} is now linked to {email}. We've let the requester know by email.
card.rejectedBody: We've emailed the requester with your explanation.
card.title: Someone says they're {name}
card.intro: In {chataName}, the account {email} is claiming this participant (email verified, {linkedCount, plural, =0 {a new account with no linked participants yet} other {the account already has linked participants}}). Does that check out?
card.otherPending: {count, plural, =0 {no other requests are waiting} one {heads-up: {count} more request is waiting} other {heads-up: {count} more requests are waiting}}
card.replacesInactive: This participant has a prepared account that has never signed in; approving will replace it with this new link.
card.reasonPlaceholder: Reason for rejecting; we'll send it to the requester (e.g. "Katka already wrote to me from a different address, get in touch if this is a mistake.")
card.footnote: Approving links the participant to the account and automatically rejects any other requests. You'll also find the request queue in the admin panel under "Claim Requests".

errors.expired: The link has expired; it was valid for 7 days. You'll find the request in the admin panel.
errors.invalid: The link is not valid. Please use the link from the email.
errors.forbidden: You no longer manage this chata. Ask another admin.
errors.already-decided: Someone has already handled this request.
errors.conflict: The participant is already linked to another active account, so the request can't be approved. If this is a mistake, sort it out in the admin panel.
errors.reason-required: Please write a reason for rejecting; we'll send it to the requester.
errors.generic: The action failed. Please try again.

expenseDecide.metaDescription: Confirming an expense somebody recorded for you

page.missingSignature: The link has no signature. Please use the link from the email.
page.expiredBody: Email links are valid for 14 days. You can find the expense in the chata's finances or in the admin panel.
page.badSignature: The link signature does not match. Please use the link from the email.
page.notFoundBody: This expense no longer exists, the author probably deleted it.
page.forbiddenBody: This link belongs to somebody who can no longer decide this expense. Talk to the banker.
page.goneTitle: This expense can no longer be confirmed
page.goneBody: The payer or the author of this expense is gone. You can find the expense in the admin panel.
page.decidedApproved: This expense has already been confirmed.
page.decidedRejected: This expense has already been rejected.
page.decidedClosed: This expense is no longer waiting.

card.title: Does this add up?
card.intro: In {chataName}, {author} recorded an expense saying {payer} paid for it.
card.introPayer: In {chataName}, {author} recorded an expense saying you paid for it.
card.introJoint: In {chataName}, {author} recorded an expense saying it was paid from the {payer} joint account.
card.introJointMember: In {chataName}, {author} recorded an expense saying it was paid from your {payer} joint account.
card.effect: Until you confirm it, the expense stays hidden and doesn't count towards the settlement.
card.reasonPlaceholder: Why doesn't it add up? (optional, we'll send it to the author)
card.approvedBody: The expense “{title}” now shows up and counts towards the settlement. We let the author know by email.
card.rejectedBody: The expense stays hidden and doesn't count towards the settlement. We emailed the author.
card.footnote: The link is valid for 14 days and is meant only for you.

errors.expired: The link expired. Talk to the banker.
errors.invalid: The link is not valid. Please use the link from the email.
errors.forbidden: This expense is no longer yours to decide.
errors.already-decided: Somebody else already decided this expense.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
